text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/repository.py:13:deprecated-method"], "search": "    return Customer.from_orm(record)", "replace": "    return Customer.model_validate(record, from_attributes=True)", "explanation": "Pydantic v2 deprecates BaseModel.from_orm(). The migration guide says to use model_validate() instead, as long as from_attributes=True is set. Passing from_attributes=True to model_validate() gives the same attribute-based validation for this ORM-style SimpleNamespace record without changing app/models.py. Customer is a Pydantic model, so this applies."}], "notes": "Only one finding is in scope (app/repository.py:13). The fix replaces the deprecated from_orm() call with model_validate(record, from_attributes=True). The from_attributes keyword is accepted by model_validate in pydantic 2.x. I did not add a config change in app/models.py, since that file is outside this edit. Nothing else in app/repository.py needs to change: make_record uses plain SimpleNamespace, not Pydantic, and the imports stay the same."}
